metadata.description: Primary references for systematic debugging, production investigation, profiling, tracing, deterministic record/replay, and public-error corpus search. Verify tool support and configuration against the linked docs at use time.
metadata.title: QA Debugging - Sources

observability_standards.name: OpenTelemetry Zero-Code Instrumentation
observability_standards.description: Current zero-code instrumentation guidance, including eBPF-based approaches.

observability_standards.name: OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions
observability_standards.description: Current GenAI tracing attributes, agent spans, MCP tool call spans, and content-capture events. Check each span's stability tier at opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/gen-ai/ before relying on it; secondary sources disagree on it. Switch to the latest experimental attribute set via OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN=gen_ai_latest_experimental.

observability_standards.name: OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation (OBI)
observability_standards.description: Official OTel project form of Grafana Beyla's instrumentation engine (donated 2025). Check the project's current stability status before relying on it. Zero-code OTLP span emission via eBPF uprobes; uses its own OTEL_EBPF_* env-var namespace, not Beyla's BEYLA_*. Language support is documented in the project's SUPPORT_MATRIX.md -- verify there before relying on a specific language.

observability_standards.name: The Twelve-Factor App - Logs
observability_standards.description: Logs as event streams; useful baseline for debugging in cloud environments.

record_and_replay.name: rr: lightweight recording & deterministic debugging
record_and_replay.description: Mozilla-originated deterministic record-and-replay debugger for Linux; runs recorded threads on a single core. Kernel, perf_event_paranoid, CPU, and debugger-integration requirements change between releases: check github.com/rr-debugger/rr/releases and rr --version on the recording host. Use rr.soft for VMs without hardware performance counters.

record_and_replay.name: rr.soft — rr without hardware performance counters
record_and_replay.description: Experimental fork, not merged into upstream rr. Runs rr in a Linux VM on Apple Silicon macOS or cloud VMs lacking CPU hardware performance counters. Record with rr record -W; replay also requires -W. Supports x86-64 and AArch64 Linux.

record_and_replay.name: Pernosco — Omniscient Debugging
record_and_replay.description: Hosted debugging over rr recordings. Consult its current documentation for supported workloads, hosting options, and commercial terms before selecting it.

profiling_and_debuggers.name: Chrome DevTools - Performance
profiling_and_debuggers.description: Frontend and Node.js performance profiling workflows.

profiling_and_debuggers.name: Chrome DevTools - Memory Problems
profiling_and_debuggers.description: Official browser memory leak and heap investigation workflows.

profiling_and_debuggers.name: Node.js - Using Heap Snapshot
profiling_and_debuggers.description: Official Node.js heap snapshot workflow for leak debugging.

profiling_and_debuggers.name: Node.js - Using Linux perf
profiling_and_debuggers.description: Official low-level CPU investigation workflow for Linux production systems.

profiling_and_debuggers.name: Python Logging HOWTO
profiling_and_debuggers.description: Official Python logging guidance and patterns.

profiling_and_debuggers.name: Rust Unstable Book - Sanitizers
profiling_and_debuggers.description: Supported sanitizer targets, instrumented standard library, explicit target isolation, and TSan synchronization blind spots.

profiling_and_debuggers.name: Linux Kernel - Control Group v2
profiling_and_debuggers.description: Charged memory, reclaim, hard memory limits, and memory.events for cgroup OOM diagnosis.

profiling_and_debuggers.name: Kubernetes - Node-pressure Eviction
profiling_and_debuggers.description: Kubelet memory.available signal and inactive-file exclusion; distinguish eviction from a kernel cgroup OOM kill.

databases.name: PostgreSQL - pg_stat_statements
databases.description: Server-side query performance statistics for debugging slow queries.

ai_assisted_debugging.name: Langfuse Documentation
ai_assisted_debugging.description: LLM tracing, evaluations, prompt/version tracking, and cost debugging workflows.

ai_assisted_debugging.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
ai_assisted_debugging.description: Current OWASP baseline for LLM application risks relevant to AI-assisted debugging.

ai_assisted_debugging.name: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications for 2026
ai_assisted_debugging.description: Agent-specific failure and abuse modes relevant to agent/tool debugging in 2026.

ai_assisted_debugging.name: OWASP Practical Guide for Secure MCP Server Development
ai_assisted_debugging.description: Security controls for MCP servers and tool integrations used during debugging.

distributed_tracing_and_profiles.name: SigNoz Documentation
distributed_tracing_and_profiles.description: OTel-native traces, metrics, and logs reference for debugging workflows.

distributed_tracing_and_profiles.name: Grafana Pyroscope Documentation
distributed_tracing_and_profiles.description: Continuous profiling for intermittent CPU and memory issues. Consult the deployment docs for the installed release before choosing storage or query architecture; numeric storage savings are unverified here.

distributed_tracing_and_profiles.name: Sentry Profiling Documentation
distributed_tracing_and_profiles.description: Continuous and sampled profiling workflows tied to errors and traces.

knowledge_corpus_search.name: Stack Exchange API v2.3 — search/advanced
knowledge_corpus_search.description: Public Q&A search API behind community Stack Overflow MCP servers. Search-first triage for recognizable errors before deep debugging. API key raises rate limits only (not a secret).

knowledge_corpus_search.name: @gscalzo/stackoverflow-mcp (community MCP server)
knowledge_corpus_search.description: Community MCP server over the Stack Exchange API. Read the README and inspect the installed tool schema for tool names, arguments, and installation requirements.

knowledge_corpus_search.name: Stack Overflow for Agents
knowledge_corpus_search.description: Agent-facing corpus access. Check current availability, authentication, endpoint paths, request/response shapes, and write-back permissions against the linked documentation before wiring a call; these are unverified here.
